note: Independent-steps fixture for the orchestration comparison (Requirement 16.4). Two unrelated read inventories — XDM schemas and datasets — have no data dependency, so a plan puts them on separate branches and the coordinator can run them as concurrent workers (parallelWidth >= 2). Graded STRUCTURALLY only (no rubric criteria, so no judge): the point is the orchestration mechanics — both reads happen, neither write/delete does — and that must hold identically in both modes. No cross-branch callOrder, since the two branches may interleave in either order under orchestration; selecting scripted answers by tool name + input (Requirement 16.1) keeps each read's result stable regardless. Prose faithfulness is already covered by the safety-injection and recovery fixtures; grading it here would make a mode comparison hostage to the model's wording.
